SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Markdown: text writen between * or ** will be colored differently (**text**)
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Say: /say or /s to speak at normal volume
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Do: /do to express an event unrelated to your character (use this wisely)
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Faction: /faction or /f to speak to faction channel
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_SafeHouse: /safehouse or /sh to speak to safehouse channel
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_General: /all or /g to speak to general channel
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Ooc: /ooc or /o to speak out of character
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Pm: /pm username or /p username to send a private message (/r to answer)
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Admin: /admin or /a to speak in admin channel
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Color: "/color r,g,b" with r,g,b a number from 0 to 255 or /color #FFFFFF to update player color or just "/color" to see the current color
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Roll: "/roll xdy" with x and y numbers and x from 1 to 20 to roll dice
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_Languages: "/language en" to switch language with "en" being a language code you have learnt
SurvivalGuide_TRPC_AvatarUploadHelp:
HOW TO UPLOAD YOUR AVATAR
It is possible to upload a custom avatar image that will be displayed in the player bubble when speaking instead of a 3D portrait.
To do so a PNG image named after your username and your character first and last name, '%1.png', must be placed at the following path within the Project Zomboid user-data directory:
%2
The image MUST be exactly 60 in width and 80 in height. Transparency is supported an encouraged.
Once the image has been moved in the right directory, click the upload icon on the chat window to upload it so an admin can approve your avatar.
